notes: S3-FIX1 (decision 2026-11-17 #5), review A medium-3 R1: two agent notes of the same origin carry the same actor.idempotency_key; the second one's sigs entry has the key 1000 (not a string), so it fails record step (3) (E_ENV_SIGS). Its envelope structure (step (2)) passes, so it still carries the claim, and the container reports N_IDEMPOTENCY_DUPLICATE (§5.4). The Python verifier skipped such records before the fix.
